page_title: WOL 1-2 HAM | Wolfsburg v Hamburger SV 07/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Marius Muller (Wolfsburg) is sent off! He receives a red card and the match ends for him. He attempts to argue, but the referee's decision is final.
90+9' Although Fabio Balde (Hamburger) is just on the bench, Florian Exner has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
90+9' That's it for today, Florian Exner has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' The resulting set piece from Wolfsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+6' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Florian Exner's book.
90+5' Wolfsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+5' Jonas Adjetey (Wolfsburg) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders. It will be a corner kick for Wolfsburg.
90+4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolfsburg comes to nothing.
90+3' Kento Shiogai (Wolfsburg) commits a foul during an attacking move. A free kick has been awarded to Hamburger SV.
90+3' Jeanuel Belocian (Wolfsburg) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Hamburger SV.
89' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Miro Muheim (Hamburger) took the corner.

89' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went straight towards the roof of the net, but Kamil Grabara made an astonishing save! The linesman makes the right call and Hamburger SV will have a corner.

88' Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) is desperate to score a goal, but he misses the target after striking the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
86' Substitution. William Mikelbrencis walks off the pitch and Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) comes on as a substitute.

85' Kento Shiogai (Wolfsburg) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
84' Damion Downs (Hamburger) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
82' Damion Downs (Hamburger) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
80' Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
79' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
79' Wolfsburg concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Hamburger SV have a free kick.
78' Daniel Bauer decides to make a substitution. Moritz Jenz will be replaced by Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Damion Downs (Hamburger) comes onto the pitch for Ransford Konigsdorffer.
76' Daniel Bauer is stunned as referee Florian Exner shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
73' The free kick is delivered by Miro Muheim (Hamburger) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
72' Kento Shiogai (Wolfsburg) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Hamburger SV are awarded the free kick.
69' Substitution. Kento Shiogai (Wolfsburg) replaces Dzenan Pejcinovic.
67' Today's match ends for Philip Otele who will be replaced by Fabio Vieira (Hamburger).
67' Merlin Polzin has decided to make a change. Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger) replaces Jean-Luc Dompe.
66' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

66' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety. Now Wolfsburg have a corner.
64' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. Wolfsburg win a corner.
63' Hamburger SV are ruled offside.
60' Substitution. Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) has come on for Jan Burger.
60' Daniel Bauer has decided to substitute Yannick Gerhardt and he is replaced by Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg).
60' A substitution has been made. Jesper Lindstrom is replaced by Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg).
58' 1 - 2 Goal! Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Kamil Grabara.
58' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) is going to take the penalty!
57' Jonas Adjetey (Wolfsburg) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
57' Jonas Adjetey (Wolfsburg) commits a rough foul. Florian Exner stops the game and makes a call. It's a penalty! Hamburger SV have an opportunity to score from the penalty spot.
57' The corner is swung in but Hamburger SV can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

56' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV have been awarded a corner kick.
55' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
52' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Florian Exner blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Hamburger SV.
47' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
46' The game is over for Daniel Elfadli. Warmed Omari (Hamburger) comes on for the second half.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+6' The free kick is whipped into the box and finds Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg), who plants a header just wide of the right post from close range. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
45+6' A player from Hamburger SV commits a rough challenge. Florian Exner blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick is awarded to Wolfsburg.
45+4' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

45+1' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hamburger SV.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Jesper Lindstrom (Wolfsburg) attempts to discuss the decision with Florian Exner, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
44' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Florian Exner blows his whistle for a foul. Wolfsburg are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
43' The referee blows his whistle as Jesper Lindstrom (Wolfsburg) was too aggressive in his challenge. A free kick to Hamburger SV.
40' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.

40' Daniel Elfadli (Hamburger) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Florian Exner no option but to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to Wolfsburg, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
39' The linesman raises his flag. Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) is adjudged offside.
38' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
38' A player from Hamburger SV commits a rough challenge. Florian Exner blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. There is a free kick near the sideline to Wolfsburg.

35' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) executes the set piece from the edge of the box in a brilliant manner! His terrific effort looks goal bound, but it only hit the left post! The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
35' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Wolfsburg is cautioned for aggressive play. Hamburger SV have been awarded a free kick.
33' 1 - 1 Goal! Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Kamil Grabara to commit before slotting the penalty low into the middle of the goal.
32' Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
32' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Florian Exner didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
32' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Hamburger SV!
31' Referee Florian Exner makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Hamburger SV. Let’s see what happens!
28' The game is interrupted now, Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
28' PENALTY APPEAL by Hamburger SV, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
28' William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
28' Florian Exner interrupts the game. One of the players from Wolfsburg won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Hamburger SV earn a free kick.
27' Wolfsburg are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
25' An attempted cross from William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) is cleared.
24' A player from Wolfsburg commits a rough challenge. Florian Exner blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Hamburger SV get a free kick.
22' 1 - 0 Goal! Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) puts the ball into the roof of the net past the outstretched arm of Daniel Heuer Fernandes.
22' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
20' The foul by Daniel Elfadli (Hamburger) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Florian Exner.

20' Daniel Elfadli (Hamburger) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Florian Exner with no other option than to blow for a foul. The referee blows his whistle and awards Wolfsburg a penalty after chaos inside the box.
20' Jesper Lindstrom (Wolfsburg) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
19' Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
18' Wolfsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

17' Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Wolfsburg are awarded a corner kick.
15' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) commits a rough challenge and Florian Exner blows his whistle for an infringement. Hamburger SV have a free kick.
14' Jesper Lindstrom (Wolfsburg) blows a clear opportunity! He needed only to tap the ball in, but narrowly misses the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hamburger SV.

13' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes pulls off a brilliant save.

12' Jonas Adjetey (Wolfsburg) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! It's a free kick to Hamburger SV in a dangerous position.
10' Florian Exner couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Vini Souza (Wolfsburg) and blew his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Hamburger SV.

9' William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.

7' The game is interrupted. Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Hamburger SV are awarded a free kick.
6' Florian Exner interrupts the game. One of the players from Wolfsburg won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Free kick. Hamburger SV will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
3' Hamburger SV keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
2' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Vini Souza (Wolfsburg) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
1' The first half has started.
Hamburger SV will kick the game off.
Florian Exner got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
